name: Slaughter Servitor (Corral)

bonuses.name: Iron Soul
bonuses.text: This Threat is unaffected by Abilities that target the mind, and never needs to make a Resolve Test to continue fighting.

abilities.name: Vice Grip
abilities.text: The Slaughter Servitor makes an Athletics Interaction Attack. If this check succeeds the target is Restrained for 1 round.

abilities.name: Gristle in the Gears
abilities.text: The Slaughter Servitor is Exhausted for 1 Round. This can be negated by the Slaughter Servitor spending an action and succeeding at a DN 3 Athletics (Str) Test.

note: No Tier row printed; class proposed (8 Wounds, no Champion bonus, a Large servitor, no Personal Ruin). The ACTIONS label is printed in the plural. Hydraulic Claws prints '9 + 3 ED / Range 1'.
